```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(matrixStats)
library(ggplot2)
source('model/data_gen_new.R')
source('model/dweibull3.R')
source('model/data_compile bivariate.R')
source('model/bayesian dpm bivariate plus survival.R')
source('model/mcmc_AF_slice bivariate.R')
source('model/cumulative_trapz.R')
source('model/simu.R')
```


```{r gene_data, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
res <- simu(varying_coef_code_sim, 
            varying_coef_code,
            n_subjects = 1000,
            sa = 8,
            sy = 0.10,
            outer_iter = 1,
            niter = 2000, nburnin = 1000, #thin = 1, 
            nchains = 1,
            save_res = F)

```

```{r eval}
dta1 <- data.frame(SUVR = res$simudata$cModelsim$y_sparse_amy, dage = res$simudata$cModelsim$dd_amy,
                  age_at_scan = res$simudata$cModelsim$t_amy, RID = res$simudata$constants$subject_amy)


ggplot(dta1, aes(x = age_at_scan, y = SUVR, group = RID, color = factor(RID))) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  xlab("Age (years)") +
  ylab("SUVR") +
  ggtitle("Amyloid SUVR") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

alpha_amy_est <- colMedians(res$res$samples[,grep("alpha", colnames(res$res$samples))][,seq(1, 2000, by = 2)])
plot(res$simudata$cModelsim$alpha[1, ], alpha_amy_est, xlab = "Ground Truth", ylab = "Posterior Medians")
abline(0, 1)

```
